title: Ninth on the leaderboard, and the Spiritual Land story
summary: North Heaven gets out of the collapsing Divine Wood Palace and repairs part of the Wood God Guard's functions, which yields the Wood God Armor, a top-grade spirit artifact that Mu Fengyang takes. The Wood God Tablet shows this ruin was one of six halls of the Divine Wood Palace, and that each tablet leads to the main hall and treasures such as the Nine-Yang Ganoderma. Collecting the fading points puts North Heaven ninth on the leaderboard. That prompts Mu Chen to tell his team, and Ji Xuan to tell Cao Gang, how Mu Chen and Luo Li went from hunter and hunted to a couple on the Spiritual Land. Liu Ying repays his debt privately and agrees to spread rumours for Mu Chen before parting. Mo Yu of the Alliance of Academies offers Ji Xuan a deal, and Ji Xuan lets the Alliance ambush and remove his rival Holy Son Cao Gang ('one Holy Son is enough'). Wu Yingying, still furious, is talked into spreading scandal about Mu Chen, and the rumour grows that 'Captain Mu is vicious while Mu Fengyang is invincible.'
